chunks: And Jamil ibn Darraj narrated, saying:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who married a bondwoman, and she came with a child. He said: “The child is attributed to his father.”
I said: “Then a slave who marries a free woman?” He said: “The child is attributed to his mother.”
ai.seo_question: In a marriage between a free person and a slave or bondwoman, to which parent is the child attributed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the attribution of a child in marriages involving a free person and a slave or bondwoman. It states that when a free man marries a bondwoman, the child follows the father, and when a male slave marries a free woman, the child follows the mother.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4581 - Jamil ibn Darraj narrated that

he asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a man who married a bondwoman, and she gave birth to a child.
Imam (as) said: "The child is attributed to his father."

I asked: "What about a slave who marries a free woman?"
Imam (as) said: "The child is attributed to his mother."
